implementation_findings: Direct root contacts need the same identity and complete continuous geometry, and their lifetime must be stated before endpoint prose can omit the repeated function.

A single common rendering context records which owned purpose was actually stated in earlier basic paragraphs. A branch can then state its realization succinctly. Standalone details retain the full function.
The first direct-contact fix alone left the prepared rook purpose repeated in every branch. It was not accepted as completion.
verdict: The shared reading and composition reduce an already-stated root function at the endpoint and prepared-function restatement across replies, while preserving both root purposes, distinct replies, late realization and mandatory costs. Re2 supplies a positive actual-screen continuity case; Qa4 preserves changed targets and a physical successor. This does not establish general concision, purpose discovery or release readiness.
limits: Only Re2 and Qa4 were run on the actual screen. No extra positions, broad regression suite or repeated performance sampling.

Conservative continuity requires the same original actor and target at their same squares and a complete relation at every observed position. Moved, interrupted, restored and successor relations are not merged by endpoint equality.
This change covers directly stated guard/attack contacts and already-announced prepared realizations. It does not create a general strategic-purpose equivalence system.
Remaining inventory statements, repeated scope labels and genuinely distinct branch costs may still make a long explanation. No claim that Qa4 was shorter or all paragraph repetition was solved.
